= title-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-04
:manname: title-subs
:manpurpose: separate title and body substitutions
:value: expanded

== Name

title-subs - separate title and body substitutions

== Synopsis

.Q01 Title *bold* {value} (C)
[quote,Writer,Book,subs="none"]
Q01 body *bold* {value} (C).

.V01 Title _italic_ {value} (R)
[verse,Poet,Poem,subs="none"]
V01 first *bold* {value} (C).
V01 second.

.Q02 Title (C) with literal pass:[(R)]
[quote,subs="-replacements"]
Q02 body (C).

.V02 Title (R) with literal pass:[(C)]
[verse,subs="-replacements"]
V02 body (R).

[cols="1a"]
|===
|.Q03 Cell title (C)
[quote,subs="none"]
Q03 cell body (C).

|.V03 Cell title (R)
[verse,subs="none"]
V03 cell body (R).
|===

.C01 Listing title (C)
[listing,subs="none"]
C01 listing body (C).

.C02 Literal title (R)
[literal,subs="none"]
C02 literal body (R).

.C03 Ordinary title (C)
[subs="none"]
C03 ordinary body (C).

Following prose (C).
